name: Fandom_Benchmark_Extended
description: An extended benchmark derived from fandom/wiki-style content that measures models' ability to answer factual and contextual questions about fictional universes and fan knowledge. It focuses on retrieval and reading-comprehension style QA over fandom texts, testing knowledge grounding and fine-grained factual recall. The dataset targets robustness of QA and retrieval models on niche, high-variance knowledge domains.
evaluation_method: exact_match (and token-level F1 for partial credit)
reputation: A niche community dataset used by hobbyist and academic groups interested in fandom/wiki QA, with modest adoption.
